map.基于刹车片当前厚度预测剩余使用寿命，保障行车安全: Predicts remaining service life from the current brake pad thickness to keep driving safe
map.磨损率 k = max( 实际磨损率, 基础预测率 ): Wear rate k = max( actual wear rate, base predicted rate )
map.实际磨损率 = (新厚度 − 当前厚度) ÷ (已行驶里程 ÷ 10000): Actual wear rate = (new thickness − current thickness) ÷ (distance driven ÷ 10000)  [mm/1000km]
map.基础预测率 = 片型系数 × 环境系数 × 习惯系数 × 位置系数: Base predicted rate = pad-type factor × environment factor × habit factor × position factor
map.位置系数：前轮 1.3（承担约 70% 制动负荷）｜后轮 0.7: Position factor: front axle 1.3 (carries about 70% of braking load) | rear axle 0.7
map.剩余可用厚度 = 当前厚度 − 极限厚度(3mm): Usable remaining thickness = current thickness − limit thickness (3mm)
map.剩余里程 = 剩余可用厚度 ÷ k × 10000: Remaining distance = usable remaining thickness ÷ k × 10000
map.说明：当存在\"已行驶里程 + 当前厚度\"实测数据时，以实测磨损率为准；否则按: Note: when measured data (distance driven + current thickness) exists, the measured wear rate governs; otherwise the prediction uses the pad-type / environment / habit / position factors. Below the 3mm limit or the 4mm warning line, replacement is advised.
map.车主根据当前刹车片厚度与近期磨损速度，估算还能跑多少公里，提前安排购买与施工。: Owners estimate how many more kilometers the pads will last from current thickness and recent wear speed, then schedule purchase and fitting.
map.网约车或营运车辆按高强度工况（频繁启停、满载）下调寿命系数，避免刹车片磨到极限引: Ride-hailing or commercial vehicles use a reduced life factor for high-intensity duty (frequent stops, full load) to avoid pads reaching the limit and creating a hazard.
map.保养顾问结合剩余厚度与报警阈值，向客户说明下次保养前是否需要更换，减少返厂。: Service advisors use remaining thickness and the warning threshold to tell customers whether pads must be changed before the next service, cutting return visits.
map.新片厚度 12mm、磨损极限 2mm（可用 10mm），已用 30000km 磨: New pads 12mm thick, wear limit 2mm (10mm usable); after 30000km worn down to 7mm (5mm consumed): wear rate = 5mm/30000km ≈ 0.167 mm/1000km, so the remaining 5mm covers about 30000km. If city traffic makes wear 1.5× faster, replace at about 20000km.
map.刹车片到多少毫米必须换？: How many millimeters before pads must be replaced?
map.多数乘用车摩擦材料剩余约 2–3mm 时达到磨损报警线，仪表提示后即应更换；若露: Most passenger-car pads reach the wear-warning line at about 2–3mm of remaining friction material; replace once the dashboard warning appears. Once the metal backing plate is exposed it scores the rotor and costs far more to repair. Heavy loads or frequent mountain braking call for earlier replacement.
map.为什么前后轮寿命差很多？: Why is there such a gap between front and rear pad life?
map.前轮承担约 70% 的制动负荷（尤其前驱车），且盘径常大于后轮，因此前片磨损远快: The front axle carries about 70% of braking load (especially on front-wheel-drive cars) and usually has larger rotors, so front pads wear much faster. Rear pads may outlast two sets of fronts, but all four wheels must be checked at every service.
map.刹车片寿命预测是一款旅行出行领域的在线工具。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用: Brake Pad Life Prediction is an online tool for travel and going out. An everyday travel essential that works offline.
map.如何使用刹车片寿命预测: How to use Brake Pad Life Prediction
map.输入新片厚度、当前厚度、已行驶里程与年均里程，选择刹车片类型、驾驶环境与位置，点: Enter new pad thickness, current thickness, distance driven and annual distance, select pad type, driving environment and axle position, then click Calculate to get remaining service distance and the recommended replacement point.
